drhp.business: The Company owns and operates infrastructure assets and provides support services, which include pipelines for transportation of petroleum products, natural gas and raw water, together with other infrastructure support services. Its services are rendered mainly to Reliance Industries Limited. Revenue is earned from transportation services and from infrastructure support services and other operating income, part of which runs on fixed-term contracts.
drhp.end_markets: Reliance Industries Limited (principal customer)|India — domestic industrial and infrastructure sector
drhp.expansion: The Annual Report discloses no expansion project, capacity addition or commissioning timeline. The Company states it continues to provide the same infrastructure facilities and support services — pipelines for transportation of petroleum products, natural gas and raw water, and other infrastructure support services — mainly to Reliance Industries Limited, with no change in the nature of its business. Asset spend during the year was confined to obsolescence management and technology upgradation of existing assets: replacement of old battery banks at Cathodic Protection stations CP-3, CP-4, …

risks.note: The AR flags that pipeline operations may be disrupted by natural calamities, equipment failures or unforeseen events, with third-party damage to pipelines in high consequence areas named as a key risk; mitigation relies on line patrolling, SOP adherence, stakeholder awareness, periodic inspections and external audits.
risks.risk: Operational disruption of pipeline operations, including third-party damage in high consequence areas

risks.note: The AR states this transportation involves inherent hazards including accidents, leakages or external threats that may impact life, property and the environment; addressed through structured inspections, hazard identification, root cause analysis, preventive measures and comprehensive insurance cover.
risks.risk: Safety, health and environment hazards inherent in transporting petroleum products and natural gas

risks.note: The Company states it provides infrastructure facilities and support services mainly to Reliance Industries Limited, and Form AOC-2 records a single material arm's-length arrangement with RIL, its promoter, covering transportation and infrastructure support services. Revenue therefore depends on one counterparty and on continuation of those arrangements.
risks.risk: Customer concentration — services provided mainly to Reliance Industries Limited

risks.note: Revenue from infrastructure support services and other operating income fell to ₹ 1,213 lakh from ₹ 1,632 lakh 'following the completion of certain fixed-term contracts', showing that contract expiry directly reduces the revenue base.

The MD&A states environmental assessments and sustainability compliance have become substantive cost items, and that regulatory and reputational considerations in this area represent material risk factors for the sector.
risks.risk: Environmental assessment and sustainability compliance costs, with regulatory and reputational exposure
